entries.name: Application Identifier (AID)
entries.description: Identifies the card application.

entries.name: Application Label
entries.description: Short application name for display.

entries.name: Track 2 Equivalent Data
entries.description: PAN, expiry, service code and discretionary data, separated by a D nibble.

entries.name: Application Primary Account Number (PAN)
entries.description: Card account number; a final F nibble may pad an odd digit count.

entries.name: Cardholder Name
entries.description: Name supplied by the card application.

entries.name: Application Expiration Date
entries.description: Application expiry as YYMMDD.

entries.name: Application Effective Date
entries.description: Application start date as YYMMDD.

entries.name: Issuer Country Code
entries.description: Issuer country using the ISO 3166 numeric code.

entries.name: Transaction Currency Code
entries.description: ISO 4217 numeric currency code.

entries.name: Language Preference
entries.description: Two-letter language codes in preference order.

entries.name: Service Code
entries.description: Three service-code digits with leading zero padding.

entries.name: Application PAN Sequence Number (PSN)
entries.description: Distinguishes cards sharing a PAN; used in key derivation.

entries.name: Transaction Currency Exponent
entries.description: Number of decimal places for the transaction currency.

entries.name: Application Template
entries.description: Groups an application directory entry.

entries.name: File Control Information (FCI) Template
entries.description: Outer template commonly returned by SELECT.

entries.name: READ RECORD Response Template
entries.description: Container for application record fields.

entries.name: Issuer Script Template 1
entries.description: Issuer commands processed before the final GENERATE AC.

entries.name: Issuer Script Template 2
entries.description: Issuer commands processed after the final GENERATE AC.

entries.name: Response Message Template Format 2
entries.description: Response whose contents are tagged data objects.

entries.name: Response Message Template Format 1
entries.description: Response whose fields are positional rather than individually tagged.

entries.name: Application Interchange Profile (AIP)
entries.description: Flags for application functions and authentication support.

entries.name: Command Template
entries.description: Carries concatenated PDOL values in GET PROCESSING OPTIONS.

entries.name: Dedicated File (DF) Name
entries.description: Selected application or directory name.

entries.name: Issuer Script Command
entries.description: An APDU embedded in an issuer script.

entries.name: Application Priority Indicator
entries.description: Application selection priority and confirmation flag.

entries.name: Short File Identifier (SFI)
entries.description: Identifies a file for record access.

entries.name: Authorisation Response Code (ARC)
entries.description: Issuer response code; used by ARPC Method 1.

entries.name: Card Risk Management Data Object List 1 (CDOL1)
entries.description: Tag/length pairs defining input order for the first GENERATE AC.

entries.name: Card Risk Management Data Object List 2 (CDOL2)
entries.description: Tag/length pairs defining input order for the second GENERATE AC.

entries.name: Cardholder Verification Method (CVM) List
entries.description: Amount thresholds followed by cardholder-verification rules.

entries.name: Certification Authority Public Key Index
entries.description: Selects a CA public key within the application RID.

entries.name: Issuer Public Key Certificate
entries.description: RSA certificate used to recover the issuer public key.

entries.name: Issuer Authentication Data
entries.description: Issuer authentication bytes; layout depends on the card profile.

entries.name: Issuer Public Key Remainder
entries.description: Issuer modulus bytes that did not fit inside its certificate.

entries.name: Signed Static Application Data (SSAD)
entries.description: Signature verified during SDA.

entries.name: Application File Locator (AFL)
entries.description: Four-byte entries identifying records and offline-authentication coverage.

entries.name: Terminal Verification Results (TVR)
entries.description: Bit flags recording terminal checks and failures.

entries.name: Transaction Certificate Data Object List (TDOL)
entries.description: Tag/length pairs defining the data for the TC hash.

entries.name: Transaction Certificate (TC) Hash Value
entries.description: SHA-1 result over the data specified by TDOL.

entries.name: Transaction Date
entries.description: Transaction date as YYMMDD.

entries.name: Transaction Status Information (TSI)
entries.description: Flags indicating processing steps performed.

entries.name: Transaction Type
entries.description: Transaction category code.

entries.name: Amount, Authorised (Numeric)
entries.description: Authorised amount encoded as twelve decimal digits.

entries.name: Amount, Other (Numeric)
entries.description: Secondary amount, such as cashback, according to the transaction profile.

entries.name: Application Identifier (AID) - Terminal
entries.description: Application identifier configured at the terminal.

entries.name: Application Usage Control
entries.description: Card usage restrictions by transaction and location.

entries.name: Application Version Number - Card
entries.description: Version supplied by the card application.

entries.name: Application Version Number - Terminal
entries.description: Application version supported by the terminal.

entries.name: Issuer Application Data (IAD)
entries.description: Profile-defined issuer data; do not assume a universal CVR layout.

entries.name: Issuer Code Table Index
entries.description: Character table used for the preferred application name.

entries.name: Application Preferred Name
entries.description: Application name encoded using the issuer code table.

entries.name: Last Online ATC Register
entries.description: ATC associated with the last online transaction.

entries.name: PIN Try Counter
entries.description: Remaining offline PIN attempts.

entries.name: Issuer Script Identifier
entries.description: Identifier used to correlate issuer-script processing.

entries.name: Terminal Country Code
entries.description: Terminal country using the ISO 3166 numeric code.

entries.name: Interface Device Serial Number
entries.description: Serial identifier for the card interface device.

entries.name: Transaction Time
entries.description: Transaction time as HHMMSS.

entries.name: Application Cryptogram (AC)
entries.description: Card-generated AAC, ARQC or TC; see 9F27 for the type.

entries.name: Cryptogram Information Data (CID)
entries.description: Cryptogram-type and associated control bits.

entries.name: Issuer Public Key Exponent
entries.description: RSA exponent used with the recovered issuer modulus.

entries.name: Terminal Capabilities
entries.description: Terminal input, verification and security capabilities.

entries.name: Cardholder Verification Method (CVM) Results
entries.description: Selected CVM, its condition and its outcome.

entries.name: Terminal Type
entries.description: Terminal environment and communication characteristics.

entries.name: Application Transaction Counter (ATC)
entries.description: Card transaction counter, also used for session-key derivation.

entries.name: Unpredictable Number (UN)
entries.description: Terminal challenge included in transaction processing.

entries.name: Processing Options Data Object List (PDOL)
entries.description: Tag/length pairs defining GET PROCESSING OPTIONS input.

entries.name: Additional Terminal Capabilities
entries.description: Additional transaction, input and output capability flags.

entries.name: Transaction Sequence Counter
entries.description: Terminal-maintained transaction sequence.

entries.name: Application Currency Code
entries.description: ISO 4217 numeric application currency.

entries.name: Application Currency Exponent
entries.description: Decimal places used for the application currency.

entries.name: Data Authentication Code (DAC)
entries.description: Value recovered from successfully verified SSAD.

entries.name: ICC Public Key Certificate
entries.description: Issuer-signed certificate used to recover the card public key.

entries.name: ICC Public Key Exponent
entries.description: RSA exponent for the card public key.

entries.name: ICC Public Key Remainder
entries.description: Card modulus bytes outside its certificate.

entries.name: Dynamic Data Authentication Data Object List (DDOL)
entries.description: Tag/length pairs defining INTERNAL AUTHENTICATE input.

entries.name: Static Data Authentication Tag List
entries.description: Tags whose values are included in offline authentication; core EMV uses AIP (82).

entries.name: Signed Dynamic Application Data (SDAD)
entries.description: Card signature used in dynamic authentication.

entries.name: ICC Dynamic Number
entries.description: Dynamic value recovered during signature verification.

entries.name: FCI Proprietary Template
entries.description: Application-specific contents within FCI.

entries.name: FCI Issuer Discretionary Data
entries.description: Issuer-defined FCI contents.
